Section 2 · Watch and discuss

The Edinburgh Fringe

2 / 3

You’re going to watch a video about an arts festival called the Edinburgh Fringe. Look at the quote and say what you think it means.

“To give anyone a stage and everyone a seat.”

Watch and complete

Watch the video to 01:30.

Discuss the questions

Would you like to attend the Edinburgh Fringe festival? Why or why not?
Do you know of any similar festivals in your city or country? Give details.
Have you ever performed on a stage? If yes, give details. If no, would you like to?
Do you know anyone who is a performer? What do they do?

Section 3 · Build your festival

Choose the best ideas for a successful festival

Plan a successful festival

You and your partner want to organize a successful festival together. Discuss the fourteen festival ideas. Decide which ideas you would include and explain your choices.

Adventure Planet
Idea 1 of 14

Discuss

  1. Have you ever been to a place like this?
  2. Would you like to visit it?
  3. Who would enjoy it the most?
  4. Would you include it in your festival? Why?
  5. What could make it even more exciting?
